name: coremods
description: A home for the user's core Claude Code mods: a git status line under the prompt, a usage band above it, and an agent status line with an expandable panel, plus read-only git log, blame and show tools for subagents and tool-mgr, which blocks Bash sed file reads and heredoc, printf and echo file writes and keeps a per-call log with DuckDB metrics. Requires Claude Code 2.1.289 or later.
